assets.name: hero-editorial
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Image 1 is a style and product identity reference for the photo area ONLY. Generate a standalone editorial product photograph to serve as the right-side hero background of this Scout website. NO website interface, NO text, NO logo, NO labels, NO buttons, NO wave ribbons. The subject is the reference's premium matte graphite black Aura One over-ear headphones, floating just above a broad pale sage textured cylindrical stone pedestal. Show accurate realistic headband, soft cushions and refined hinges. Warm ivory #F6F4EF studio environment with gentle warm natural sunlight, faint out-of-focus greenery at the very far right edge only, tactile limestone and matte product surfaces. Wide composition; product dominates center-right with the left third almost empty softly lit ivory for a seamless transition to the website's background. The pedestal enters from the lower edge; headphones and full headband are completely visible. Sophisticated premium consumer product photography matching the reference hero, no marketing graphics. Very clean, not busy, not glossy CGI.
